source_name: MINT Fintech Group — Macedonian super-app (payments, FX, loyalty)
why_relevant: Local group launching an integrated app bundling payments, insurance, loyalty, travel and FX — exactly the kind of product-launch signal this cell exists to catch. Official domain unconfirmed; currently reachable through mk business media.

source_name: ЦРРСМ — Регистар на вистински сопственици (Register of Beneficial Owners)
why_relevant: Statutory UBO register run by ЦРРСМ under the AML/CFT law in cooperation with the Financial Intelligence Unit (Управа за финансиско разузнавање), built with GIZ support. Reveals the natural persons behind MK payment-services companies, e-money issuers, exchange offices and fintech vendors — the ownership layer that never appears in marketing material and that matters for partner due diligence and for spotting the same owners behind multiple payments entities.

source_name: NBRSM — Decision on publication of reports and data by banks (Одлука за објавување извештаи и податоци од страна на банката)
why_relevant: The legal instrument that COMPELS each bank to publish disclosure reports (MK Pillar-3 analogue), Official Gazette 36/23, applied from 1 Jan 2025. Defines what every bank must publish, in what format and on what deadline — i.e. it specifies the shape of the entire per-bank disclosure corpus a scout can then collect from bank websites.

source_name: НБРМ — CaSys system oversight page (International Card System AD)
why_relevant: Regulator's own description of CaSys as a designated payment system (multilateral deferred net settlement for domestic-brand cards; operates banks' ATM and POS networks with authorisation/switching). Independent confirmation of the switch's role and settlement linkage into MIPS.

source_name: NBRSM — Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems (Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи)
why_relevant: The PSD2-aligned primary law creating the payment-institution and e-money-institution categories and the register obligations. Defines the entire regulated-actor taxonomy this cell maps.

source_name: Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems (ЗПУПС) — consolidated text and explanatory materials
why_relevant: The MoF-drafted PSD2-style law (in force from 20 April 2022; market opening for new payment service providers and e-money issuers from 1 January 2023) is the legal anchor for the entire MK payments-competition question. This government-hosted PDF and the NBRM presentation of the same law are the accessible full texts.

source_name: KHV — Регулатива / Закон за проспекти и обврски за транспарентност за издавачите на хартии од вредност
why_relevant: The prospectus/transparency law defines issuer disclosure duties and periodic-reporting deadlines — the legal spine that makes this whole cell a predictable, calendarable stream. Related: Закон за хартии од вредност (consolidated text).

source_name: MSE годишни извештаи за работа (Exchange's own annual reports)
why_relevant: Annual narrative on listing activity, new issuers, turnover and disclosure-compliance — useful long-run context and a pointer to structural changes in the disclosure regime.

source_name: Macedonian Stock Exchange annual conference (24th edition) — agenda & participants
why_relevant: The country's main finance/capital-market event; agenda, panelists and sponsor banks indicate which institutions are positioning publicly and on what themes.

source_name: Институт на овластени ревизори / сметководители — professional-body materials on the Register of Annual Accounts
why_relevant: Practitioner training material authored with ЦРРСМ describing exactly how the Register of Annual Accounts works: which schemes are filed, by whom, in what format, what audit attachments are required and what the retrieval products are. This is the cheapest way to learn the internal structure of the filings before designing extraction, and it names the field vocabulary used in MK balance-sheet schemes.

source_name: World Bank — SEPA / Western Balkans payments features and country news
why_relevant: Narrative and quantified framing of MK's SEPA accession impact on cross-border payment costs — useful analytical context that local sources rarely quantify.

source_name: Стопанска комора — annual activity reports (Годишен извештај, PDF archive)
why_relevant: Chamber annual reports document which sectoral associations met, what positions were adopted and which companies participated — a durable historical record of banking/payments advocacy. The /Upload/Documents/ path is a predictable PDF repository worth enumerating.

source_name: BIS CPMI Red Book - Payment, clearing and settlement systems in Macedonia
why_relevant: Authoritative structural description of MK payment infrastructure (MIPS, KIBS, card processing). Dated, but it is the baseline that lets a vendor announcement be interpreted - which scheme, which rail, which operator.

source_name: ProCredit Holding — Disclosure (Pillar 3) Reports
why_relevant: Pillar 3 disclosure gives country-by-country reporting (CBCR) — MK-level turnover, profit before tax, tax paid and headcount — a rare hard number set for a foreign-owned MK bank, mandated by CRR Art. 89.

source_name: National instant-payment initiative (TIPS clone / Western Balkans) — NBRM announcements as carried by MK media
why_relevant: The single biggest structural change in MK payments infrastructure: connection to a TIPS clone for 24/7 instant payments, alongside Albania and Kosovo, with proxy-lookup (pay-by-mobile-number) planned. Media carry NBRM statements with dates and milestones that are not always on the bank's own news page.

source_name: Asseco SEE (ASEE) case studies and news - Komercijalna banka DMS case study
why_relevant: A downloadable ASEE case study PDF on a Document Management System delivered to Komercijalna banka (project from 2010). ASEE is one of the dominant SEE banking/payments vendors, so its case-study library and news feed are a systematic route to MK bank system ownership.

source_name: Central Cooperative Bank AD Sofia — Annual Report (EN)
why_relevant: Direct parent of CCB AD Skopje. The Sofia group annual report consolidates the MK subsidiary and discloses group total assets plus subsidiary-level participations; the English edition is the accessible channel for MK-relevant numbers not separately published in Skopje.

source_name: Entrust newsroom - card issuance / digital card customer announcements
why_relevant: Names Komercijalna Banka AD Skopje explicitly, dates the relationship back to 1995 for central card issuance, and names the local implementation partner BCS North Macedonia - simultaneously a vendor fact and a new actor (BCS) to snowball.

source_name: Flex Pay (Флекс пеј) — licensed MK e-money institution
why_relevant: One of the newest domestic EMI licensees; a target actor whose product launches will define local wallet competition. Own corporate domain not confirmed in this pass — currently trackable only through media carrying its releases.

source_name: Netcetera (G+D Netcetera) references / customer stories - Halkbank MK digital wallet
why_relevant: Explicit vendor customer page naming Halkbank AD Skopje: contactless mobile wallet, first MK wallet using CDCVM, with Mastercard MDES and Visa VTS tokenisation. Exactly the procurement-revealing artefact the cell targets.

source_name: Ohridska Banka AD Skopje — Steiermärkische group page (mk/en)
why_relevant: Legacy site of Ohridska Banka documenting the 2019 change of ownership to the Sparkasse/Steiermärkische group and the 2020–21 merger with Sparkasse Banka Makedonija. Useful for ownership-history reconstruction and for the local-language framing of the parent relationship.

source_name: Open Government Partnership — commitment MK0122 'Public Access to the Central Register'
why_relevant: Independent, dated documentation of what the Central Registry committed to open up, what actually shipped and what stalled. The best external evidence on how open MK registry data really is — directly informing whether free public access or the paid Distributive System is the realistic collection route, and where advocacy/FOI pressure has already been tried.

source_name: ResearchGate — MK banking-sector studies (e.g. 'Efficiency of the Macedonian banking sector')
why_relevant: Author-deposited copies of MK banking papers that are otherwise behind conference proceedings or vanished journal sites; useful for recovering datasets and citation trails into further MK-authored work.

source_name: US ITA Country Commercial Guide — North Macedonia: Selling to the Public Sector
why_relevant: English-language orientation to how MK public procurement actually works for foreign vendors — thresholds, portal mechanics, IFI-financed routes and known frictions. Useful onboarding context and a cross-check on the legal reading, refreshed roughly annually.

source_name: zk.mk business registry entry — МБА Македонска Банкарска Асоцијација
why_relevant: Third-party company-registry aggregator carrying registration identifiers, address and officers for the association itself (and, via the same site, for chambers such as Стопанска комора на северо-западна Македонија). Useful for entity resolution when linking association entities to Central Register filings.
